sectors.trend: Iron ore in sustained downtrend pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG; gold miners outperforming on safe-haven demand and new discoveries
sectors.implications: Rotate out of iron ore exposure; favour gold (GOLD.AX, NZG.AX, FOR.AX, KAL.AX, LRV.AX, ARK.AX) and uranium (INF.AX). BHP.AX faces margin compression risk.

sectors.trend: Big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) under pressure; property sector 'GFC moment' raises NPL concerns; mortgage stress rising
sectors.implications: Watch credit cost provisions; property-linked lending exposure a key risk. Defensive yield still attractive but capital preservation at risk.

sectors.trend: Oil prices elevated on Hormuz Strait escalation; Santos gas cartel narrative creates regulatory and pricing volatility
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, XTL.AX benefit from oil spike; Santos (STO.AX) faces political/regulatory headwinds. LNG names (GAS.AX, QGN.AX) supported.

sectors.trend: Donor fund misappropriation at prominent institute raises governance concerns; global oncology M&A (McKesson $2.25B) signals sector consolidation
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) relatively insulated; monitor governance risk in smaller biotech. Oncology M&A tailwind for global peers.

sectors.trend: Qantas $35M payout signals structural cost pressure; supply crunch hitting auto/insurance; mortgage costs forcing dual-income households
sectors.implications: QAN.AX under earnings pressure; consumer discretionary (WOW.AX, LPX.AX) faces demand softening. Insurance (CGU.AX, WBC.AX) premiums rising on supply crunch.

sectors.trend: ATO vs Big Tech tax dispute; social media algorithm regulation; global tech volatility (Nvidia, Okta +20%, Apple AI)
sectors.implications: ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) faces regulatory overhang. Global tech (NVDA, OKTA, AAPL) provides sentiment spillover. Crypto/BlackRock (BLK) flows notable.

sectors.trend: Property industry 'GFC moment'; NZ house crash; construction capacity deficit; carbon plan collapse affecting rural land values
sectors.implications: Property REITs (VCG.AX, DGP.AX, ICV.AX) face occupancy and valuation risk. Construction (WBC.AX, GPT.AX) constrained by capacity. Rural land (NT cattle $26M sale) reflects carbon policy uncertainty.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower. Iron ore weakness and bank/tech pressure offset by energy and gold. Hormuz escalation adds oil-driven volatility. RBA on hold but inflation risk from oil. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a tight band with sector rotation dominating.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds: iron ore decline, property correction, living standards squeeze. Gold and energy transition names offer relative strength. Consumer and property sectors face 6-12 month pressure. RBA may need to hold rates longer if oil-driven inflation persists. AUD/USD vulnerable on commodity mix shift.
